name: Arista Networks
description: Arista sells high-speed Ethernet switches and routers, and the software that runs them (EOS), mainly to the largest cloud and AI data-center operators, plus enterprises and campus buildings. Product (hardware with software) was 85.8% of Q2 2026 revenue and services (support contracts, growing as installed base grows) 14.2%. Concentration is the defining feature: one customer was 16% and another 26% of 2025 revenue (15% and 20% in 2024; coverage names Microsoft and Meta as the two above 10%). Revenue reached $9.006B in 2025 (+28.6%) and $3.036B in Q2 2026 (+37.7%). Gross margin is compressing with mix (62.9% in Q2 2026 vs 65.2%).

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recalled from the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. The label hides that two customers were 42% of 2025 revenue.

hq.note: Building a new Santa Clara campus at estimated $170M to $195M more capex through end of 2026 (FY2025 10-K coverage)

businessLines.name: Product (switches, routers, software licences)
businessLines.how: One-time hardware sales of switches and routers with embedded EOS software, ordered in large batches by cloud and AI data-center builders; deferred revenue for undelivered items reached $6,865.9M (2026-06-30), up from $4,061.7M a year earlier.
businessLines.marketShare: 18.7% of datacenter Ethernet switch revenue in Q2 2026 (20.7% in Q1 2026)

businessLines.name: Services (support and subscriptions)
businessLines.how: Annual support contracts sold with each hardware order and renewed each year; grows with the size of the installed base.

brands.name: VeloCloud
brands.note: Cloud WAN business acquired June 2025 for $300M

whatsNext.text: Santa Clara headquarters building expected to complete by end of fiscal 2026

profileAgainst: Q2 2026 10-Q (period ended 2026-06-30) and Q2 release 2026-08-04; FY2025 results release (Feb 2026) and 10-K
